title: The morph — collapsed pill ⇄ expanded island

spec.design_question: When the pill becomes the island (and back), what is the ink's contract during the ~220ms container morph: does the pill's top band hand off into the header mid-flight (overlap crossfade), does the advancing bottom edge reveal ink already laid out in place (edge reveal), or does the glass morph empty and print its ink after (sequential print)?
spec.current_state: The morph does not exist today — expand/collapse is a HARD CUT. `setExpanded` calls `renderNow()` (HUDPanelController.swift:227-233), which runs `render()` → `present(content:size:)`: the old content view is removed, `panel.setContentSize(size)` snaps the panel to the new size, new content is added, the frame origin is recomputed top-center, and `invalidateShadow()` fires (HUDPanelController.swift:326-338). There is no NSAnimationContext/CATransaction anywhere in Sources; the ONLY animation in the app is the 0.12s ease-out hover fill fade, which already models the Reduce Motion contract (instant swap when `accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion`, HUDPanel.swift:90-104). Geometry: the collapsed pill is height 36 with dynamic width — 52px check/loading pill, 60px for glyph+1-digit count (18+6+10+26), ~88px segmented gauge (CollapsedPillView.swift:8,11-34); the expanded island is width 520 (IslandContentView.swift:9) with REACTIVE height = fittingHeight clamped to screen (HUDPanelController.swift:295-312); per-lane cap 240 with whole-row snap-down (IslandGeometry.swift:19; IslandContentView.swift:136-153,186-196). Both states anchor top-center, top edge fixed 8px under the menu bar (IslandGeometry.swift:21,29-33). Corner radius 14 continuous in both states (HUDPanelController.swift:32; CollapsedPillView.swift:44); the vibrant surface clips via a stretchable rounded maskImage with capInsets, so the radius holds during any frame change (IslandSurfaceFactory.swift:41,85-95); solid themes (GitHub = solid #0D1117) clip via masksToBounds (IslandSurfaceFactory.swift:53-57). Panel has a system shadow (HUDPanelController.swift:48). Overflow affordance today: overlay scrollers only, autohiding — no bottom fade exists (IslandContentView.swift:209-216). Hide/show is also a hard cut: `hide()` flips isVisible, `orderOut`, then funnels through `setExpanded(false)` (HUDPanelController.swift:186-201); while hidden the only presence is the status item's STATIC template glyph `dot.radiowaves.left.and.right` — it carries no state (D-glyph deliberately excluded), it is the handle back via left-click or the "Show island" menu item (StatusItemController.swift:64-71,129-134,213-217). Click-away monitor exists only while expanded (HUDPanelController.swift:240-254). GitHub theme palette confirmed at Theme.swift:111-118: surface #0D1117, border #30363D, ink #E6EDF3/#7D8590/#484F58, accent #2F81F7, danger #F85149, caution #D29922, success #3FB950.

variants.name: Hand-off — the pill grows into the header
variants.essence: One continuous surface morphs on a single curve while the pill's top band crossfades into the expanded header in place — the pill is revealed to have been the island's header all along, with no empty-glass beat.
variants.spec: TRIGGER: pill click / status-item left-click (existing toggleExpand). EXPAND (220ms total, ONE NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup, ctx.duration=0.22, ctx.timingFunction=cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), allowsImplicitAnimation=true): panel frame animates pill rect (e.g. 60×36, top-center) → island rect (520×H reactive, mock H=346), top edge fixed at visibleFrame.maxY−8, horizontal center fixed, width and height on the SAME curve simultaneously; corner radius constant 14 (no radius animation). CONTENT: build the expanded IslandContentView at final size immediately, add at opacity 0; pill ink (glyph+count cluster) stays pinned at its screen position in the top band and fades 1→0 over 0–100ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); header ("Needs you" + count badge + gear + chevron) fades 0→1 over 80–200ms; body lanes + "GitHub inbox ↗" footer fade 0→1 over 120–220ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1). No per-row stagger, no translation on any text — the hand-off is the top BAND (pill band 36px → header band, top pad 16 + 22px header), not a traveling glyph. COLLAPSE (180ms, same curve): body+footer fade 1→0 over 0–70ms, header 1→0 over 0–100ms, frame 520×H→pill rect over 0–180ms, pill ink fades 0→1 over 100–180ms. CAPPED-LANE BOTTOM FADE: 24px CAGradientLayer mask (opaque→transparent, last 24px) on any lane whose content exceeds its snapped frame; it fades in WITH the body ink (120–220ms window — it is printed ink, not separate chrome); at rest it is static; it disappears with a 120ms ease-out when the user scrolls the lane to its end and returns on scroll-back (motion maps to the user's scroll). HIDE (menu item): if expanded, run the 180ms collapse first, then the pill fades 1→0 with an 8px upward translate (the menuBarGap — it tucks under the bar it hangs from) over 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1), then orderOut; the signal now lives ONLY in the static status-item glyph (the handle — no glyph change, no flash: attention-non-theft). SHOW: orderFront at opacity 0, pill fades 0→1 with 8px downward settle, 140ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1). REDUCE MOTION: if accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion, skip every group — present() hard cut exactly as today (HUDPanel.swift:90-104 pattern); hide/show = plain orderOut/orderFront. INTERRUPTION: re-toggle mid-flight issues a new runAnimationGroup; layer-backed frame + opacity retarget from presentation values (single simultaneous curve = trivially retargetable). Shadow: hasShadow stays true through flight; invalidateShadow() once in the group's completion handler.
variants.doctrine_fit: Motion maps 1:1 to the summon click; one continuous object = nothing appears from nowhere; all fades are opacity-only ink (survives gray-swap trivially); no idle motion, no hover trigger (click-summon only, the anti-hover-trap stance); calm: one curve, no stagger, no overshoot; fabricates nothing — the band hand-off crossfades real content at its real position, no fake traveling glyph.
variants.risks: present() must be restructured to keep the outgoing pill content alive during flight (today it is removed synchronously — HUDPanelController.swift:327), the main build delta. The 0–100ms/80–200ms overlap can read as brief double-exposure in the top band if the pill count and header badge are both mid-opacity — needs one real-size check. Collapse-then-fade on Hide is a 320ms two-beat sequence; if it feels long, cut straight to the fade from the expanded state.
variants.mock_notes: Self-contained HTML/CSS/JS over a desktop-wallpaper background (CSS gradient is fine). Menu bar: fixed 24px strip, rgba(20,22,26,.85). Island: position fixed, top 32px (24 bar + 8 gap), left 50%, transform translateX(-50%); background #0D1117; border 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,.8); border-radius 14px; box-shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35); overflow hidden. Animate width 60px→520px and height 36px→346px with transition: width 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), height 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1). Pill ink: absolutely positioned cluster centered in a 60×36 band — glyph (13px, #E6EDF3) + count "3" (13px 600, font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, #E6EDF3); fade out 100ms. Expanded content at fixed 520px width inside: padding 16px 18px; header row 22px high — "Needs you" 11px 600 #7D8590, count badge (height 16, radius 8, background #2F81F7, white 11px 700, padding 0 7px), flex spacer, two 24×22 icon buttons (#7D8590); body margin-top 8, row spacing 8; radar rows: 20px icon column + 8px gap + stack of title 13px 500 #E6EDF3 / subtitle 11px #7D8590 tabular-nums / optional excerpt 11px #484F58, all ellipsis-truncated; section header "Your PRs" 11px 600 #7D8590; caption "3 stale · untouched 14d+" 11px #484F58; footer "GitHub inbox ↗" 11px #484F58. Overflow demo: give the radar lane 7+ rows, cap the lane at 226px (6 whole 31px rows + 5×8 gaps, snapped under the 240 cap), overflow-y auto, and apply the bottom fade as -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black calc(100% - 24px), transparent); toggle the mask off when scrollTop reaches bottom (JS scroll listener, 120ms opacity transition on a wrapper). Header/body opacity transitions with transition-delay 80ms/120ms. Wrap all transitions in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { transition: none !important } } and add a toggle button to replay expand/collapse plus a Hide/Show demo (opacity + translateY(-8px), 140ms).

variants.name: Unfurl — width leads, the edge reveals
variants.essence: Dynamic-Island-style two-axis choreography: the pill snaps wide first, then the bottom edge unfurls downward, revealing rows already laid out in their final places — content never fades or moves, the real edge is the only performer.
variants.spec: EXPAND (240ms total, one NSAnimationContext transaction hosting two keyframed layer animations): width 60→520 over 0–120ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1); height 36→H over 60–240ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) (spring-flavored decel, zero overshoot — calm, not bouncy); top edge fixed at visibleFrame.maxY−8, horizontal center fixed; radius constant 14; the surface's masksToBounds/maskImage clips throughout (IslandSurfaceFactory.swift:41,55 — the stretchable capInset mask already holds corners during frame changes). CONTENT: the full expanded content is built and framed at FINAL size at t=0 and simply clipped by the growing container — rows, section headers, and footer are revealed in place by the advancing bottom edge; zero opacity animation on the body. The ONLY crossfade: pill ink fades 1→0 over 0–60ms; header fades 0→1 over 60–140ms (it needs the width to exist first). COLLAPSE (200ms, reverse order): height H→36 over 0–140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) (body scroll offsets stashed per existing ScrollOffsets mechanics), width 520→pill over 80–200ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1); header out 0–60ms, pill ink in 120–200ms. CAPPED-LANE BOTTOM FADE: the SAME 16–24px soft gradient rides the advancing bottom edge during flight (content dissolves into the moving edge rather than hard-clipping), and when the morph settles the identical 24px gradient mask remains on any overflowing capped lane — the affordance is continuous with the morph: "more below this edge" is one statement mid-flight and at rest; removed/restored on scroll-to-end with 120ms ease. HIDE: collapse morph (200ms) then the pill shrinks into its own top edge — scaleY 1→0.6 anchored top + opacity 1→0 over 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) — then orderOut; status item stays the static handle (no glyph change/flash). SHOW: orderFront, scaleY 0.6→1 anchored top + opacity 0→1, 160ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1). REDUCE MOTION: whole transaction skipped → today's hard cut; hide/show = plain orderOut/orderFront. INTERRUPTION: both axes are layer frame animations; a mid-flight toggle reads presentation-layer size and starts the reverse phases from there — the height phase's 60ms delay is dropped on retarget (whichever axis is mid-flight animates immediately from its presentation value).
variants.doctrine_fit: The purest never-fabricate content contract: rows never pretend to materialize or travel — they exist at final positions from t=0 and a REAL edge reveals them; motion is exclusively the container's true size change plus one header fade; the bottom fade doubles as the overflow affordance, so mid-flight and at-rest meaning are identical; ink-only, gray-swap safe; click-mapped, no idle motion.
variants.risks: The most designed motion in the set — two overlapping phases at 240ms is the closest to 'busy' and must be judged at real size over a real desktop (the PRESSURE attention-non-theft screen-recording test). Interruptible retargeting across a delayed second phase is the trickiest build of the three (still one transaction, but phase bookkeeping is real). On a tall island the last row lands at 240ms — measurably later than the current cut. Late-reveal also means the footer trust link is the last thing to appear.
variants.mock_notes: Same base as variant 1 (island fixed top 32px centered, #0D1117, 1px rgba(48,54,61,.8) border, radius 14, shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45), overflow hidden). Two-phase via explicit transitions: transition: width 120ms cubic-bezier(.3,0,0,1), height 180ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) 60ms (delay on height); collapse swaps to height 140ms 0ms, width 120ms 80ms. Content div fixed at width 520px / height 346px inside the clipping container so rows sit at final positions and get wiped in. Advancing-edge softness: an absolutely positioned 20px gradient strip (linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #0D1117)) pinned to the container's bottom inner edge during the animation (JS adds class while transitioning height, removes on transitionend), which then hands off to the persistent capped-lane mask (-webkit-mask-image linear-gradient, last 24px) on the 226px-capped radar lane. Header opacity transition 80ms delay 60ms; pill ink fade 60ms. Typography/palette identical to variant 1 (11/13px, #E6EDF3 / #7D8590 / #484F58, badge #2F81F7). Hide demo: transform-origin top center; transform scaleY(.6) + opacity 0, 120ms. prefers-reduced-motion kills all transitions. Replay controls: Expand/Collapse/Hide/Show buttons.

variants.name: Sequential print — the glass moves empty, ink prints after
variants.essence: A strict three-beat sequence: outgoing ink blinks off, the empty glass resizes as one clean object, incoming ink prints on — text never stretches, clips, or coexists mid-flight; closest to the existing teardown/rebuild render path.
variants.spec: EXPAND (220ms total, one NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup): pill ink opacity 1→0 over 0–60ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); container frame pill rect→520×H over 0–180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) (top edge fixed, center fixed, radius constant 14); expanded content — built at final frame via the EXISTING present() flow, added at opacity 0 — fades 0→1 as one block over 120–220ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1). Beats overlap only at the seams; between 60–120ms the island is deliberately empty glass. COLLAPSE (180ms mirror): content 1→0 over 0–50ms, frame over 30–160ms, pill ink 0→1 over 100–180ms. This variant needs NO snapshots and NO shared elements: it is the current architecture (remove old content / setContentSize / add new content, HUDPanelController.swift:326-338) with three opacity+frame animations laid over it — the cheapest faithful build. CAPPED-LANE BOTTOM FADE: part of the printed ink — the 24px gradient mask on overflowing capped lanes arrives inside the same 120–220ms content fade, static at rest, 120ms ease off/on at scroll-to-end. HIDE: no collapse detour and no implied destination — the island (whatever state) fades opacity 1→0 in place over 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1), then orderOut; it doesn't 'go' anywhere because nothing physical persists — the status item (static glyph) is simply the handle, which is the literal truth of the architecture. SHOW: orderFront at opacity 0 → 1 over 140ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) at final position, no translate. REDUCE MOTION: skip the group → today's hard cut everywhere. INTERRUPTION: the simplest retarget in the set — frame and three opacities restart from presentation values in a fresh group; the empty-glass beat also makes mid-flight reversal visually clean (no text ever reverses direction).
variants.doctrine_fit: Maximally honest to what the code actually does (content IS rebuilt, not moved — this variant refuses to theatricalize that); zero fabricated continuity of any glyph; calm by subtraction — one moving object, ink strictly before/after; opacity-only ink is gray-swap safe; click-mapped motion only; hide/show fabricates no physical metaphor at all.
variants.risks: The 60ms empty-glass beat can read as a flicker or a loading blink on fast displays — the premium feel of the morph depends on ink continuity this variant deliberately gives up. PLAN calls the morph 'the signature move'; this is the anti-signature reading, and if the record wants a wow-moment this is the wrong pick. The in-place Hide fade gives the user no spatial hint that the status item is the way back (mitigated only by the menu item's naming).
variants.mock_notes: Same base geometry/palette as variant 1 (60×36 → 520×346, top 32px, radius 14, #0D1117, border rgba(48,54,61,.8), same shadow). Implementation is three stacked layers inside the clipping container: .pill-ink (opacity transition 60ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1)), .container (width/height 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)), .island-ink (opacity 100ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) with transition-delay 120ms). Sequence driven by a single .expanded class on the root. Emphasize the empty-glass beat in the mock — it is the thing the human must judge, so include a 0.25× slow-motion replay toggle (multiply all durations ×4 via a CSS custom property --t: 1; durations written as calc(180ms * var(--t))). Content markup identical to variant 1 (header 11px 600 #7D8590 + badge #2F81F7 16px/r8 + 24×22 icon buttons; rows 13px 500 #E6EDF3 over 11px #7D8590 tabular-nums; footer 11px #484F58; capped radar lane 226px with the 24px mask fade). Hide/Show demo: opacity-only 140ms, no transform. prefers-reduced-motion: all transitions none.

recommendation.why: It delivers the signature single-object morph the PLAN asks for while staying the easiest to keep interruptible — one simultaneous curve retargets trivially from presentation values, unlike the unfurl's delayed second phase — and it avoids the sequential-print's empty-glass flicker. Its band hand-off crossfades real content at real positions (no fake traveling glyph), so it survives never-fabricate and calm-never-busy on its face. The build delta (keep outgoing pill ink alive through flight) is modest and confined to present(), the exact seam HUDPanelController already owns.

verdicts.reason: Doctrine-clean on every hunted axis: motion maps 1:1 to the summon/collapse/hide clicks (no ambient motion), all transitions are opacity+frame ink that survives gray-swap, no color is introduced beyond the verified existing palette (accent badge is existing chrome), click-summon not hover, Reduce Motion honored via the exact HUDPanel.swift:90-104 pattern, and every code citation verified (present() teardown at HUDPanelController.swift:326-338, hover fade as the app's only animation — grep confirms zero NSAnimationContext/CATransaction in Sources). The one violation is in the mock spec: pill ink count '3' and (implicitly) the header badge alongside an 'Overflow demo: give the radar lane 7+ rows'. Code guarantees badge == rows.count (IslandContentView.swift:36) and pill count == rows.count (CollapsedPillView.swift:32-33), so a 3-vs-7+ mock shows a glance-count the architecture can never produce — a fabricated state in the exact artifact the human will judge as real. The 320ms two-beat Hide is within calm bounds and the risks section already pre-registers the fallback (cut straight to fade); no amendment needed there.
verdicts.amendment: In the mock, set pill count, header badge, and visible radar rows to the SAME number (e.g. 7 — still one digit, so the 60px pill width math is unchanged). Nothing else changes.

verdicts.reason: Motion is click-mapped, ink-only, gray-swap safe, Reduce Motion honored — no kill-grade violation. But the variant's load-bearing never-fabricate claim ('rows exist at final positions from t=0 and never move — the real edge is the only performer') is unspecified at the one point where it silently fails: the container is CENTER-anchored, so during the width phase (0-120ms) its left edge travels; the mock says only 'content div fixed at 520px inside the clipping container', and a child anchored to that moving edge SLIDES horizontally on screen — the essence's honesty contract breaks in both mock and build without anyone deciding it. Second, the doctrine_fit sentence 'motion is exclusively the container's true size change plus one header fade' is false as written: HIDE/SHOW scaleY(1→0.6) squashes the pill's live glyph+count while still partially opaque — legible ink distorting is exactly the text-never-stretches line variant 3 draws, and an oversold doctrine_fit is how a variant sneaks past review. (The mid-flight edge fade handing off to the capped-lane mask at settle is a small position jump of the same token — acceptable, completion-of-click-mapped, but worth one real-size look.) Inherits variant 1's count-consistency fix.
verdicts.amendment: (a) Pin the expanded content to the container's CENTER so it is screen-fixed while width animates — mock: position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:520px; build: counter-anchor the content to the final rect during the width phase (state this in the spec as the mechanism backing 'revealed in place'). (b) On HIDE, complete the pill-ink fade before scaleY reaches legibility-distorting range (ink out by ~60ms of the 120ms) or replace scaleY with opacity-only — and correct the doctrine_fit sentence to admit the hide/show transform. (c) Apply variant 1's count-consistency fix (badge/pill/rows agree).

verdicts.reason: The cleanest doctrine profile of the three, and its claims about the code are all true (verified: it really is the current remove-content/setContentSize/add-content path at HUDPanelController.swift:326-338 plus three overlays). Motion is exclusively click-mapped; zero fabricated continuity — it deliberately refuses to theatricalize a teardown/rebuild as object permanence; the 60ms empty-glass beat is a transitional non-state, not a fabricated 'clear' claim (the user just clicked; pulse-honesty is untouched); opacity-only ink is gray-swap trivial; the in-place opacity Hide fabricates no spatial metaphor at all; Reduce Motion honored; simplest interruption story. Its acknowledged weaknesses (anti-signature, no spatial hint to the status item) are product-taste calls the human session exists to make, not doctrine violations — and the mock's 0.25x slow-mo replay is exactly the right instrument for judging the flicker risk. Its mock markup is 'identical to variant 1', so variant 1's count fix flows through automatically.

review.overall_note: All ~30 file:line citations in current_state were verified against source and are ACCURATE (including the subtle ones: no NSAnimationContext/CATransaction anywhere in Sources; hover fade is the only animation; Theme.swift:111-118 GitHub hexes match exactly; runtime pill is 36-high/dynamic-width even though IslandGeometry.collapsedSize is a vestigial 280x42 pre-render contentRect). Three things the human session must not miss: (1) SHARED MOCK BUG — all three mocks inherit a pill/badge count of '3' beside a 7+-row capped radar lane; code binds both counts to rows.count (IslandContentView.swift:36, CollapsedPillView.swift:32-33), so fix variant 1's markup once (use 7 everywhere) and it propagates. (2) SCOPE BLEED — every variant also specifies the capped-lane bottom fade, which is the SEPARATE 'Expanded island anatomy' exploration item (plan 2026-07-02-001 lines 167-170); whatever fade behavior gets ratified here pre-empts that record — decide it once, on purpose, not by accident. The fade specs themselves are doctrine-clean (static at rest, scroll-mapped removal, hue-free). (3) RECOMMENDATION — defensible but not the doctrine-SAFEST: morph-glass-then-ink is technically safest; morph-hand-off-header is the right pick because it is doctrine-clean after amendment, uniquely delivers the PLAN's explicit 'signature move' (plan lines 157-160), and retargets trivially. The judged failure mode is the 80-200ms top-band double-exposure at real size — if it fails, the pre-cleared fallback is variant 3, not variant 2. Build burden for whichever wins: the scroll-to-end fade listener must be event-driven (clip-view bounds-change, live only while expanded) to keep the idle-footprint row payable.
